sentences.zh: 你知道，研究中出现的那些信件，真的让人感到既触动又心酸，

sentences.en: and indicative of where we were going as a culture.
sentences.zh: 也反映了我们当时的文化走向。

sentences.en: You know, people saying, please tell me your name.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们会说，请告诉我你的名字。

sentences.en: I won't tell anybody else, but please tell me your name.
sentences.zh: 我不会告诉别人，但请告诉我你的名字。

sentences.en: And just this yearning that comes across, and it's a new kind of yearning.
sentences.zh: 那种流露出来的渴望，是一种全新的渴望。

sentences.en: Soon, movie studios had no choice but to yield to their audience's demands
sentences.zh: 很快，电影制片厂别无选择，只能屈服于观众的需求，

sentences.en: and start identifying and then promoting their stars.
sentences.zh: 开始确认并推广他们的明星。

sentences.en: Once you name one star, you've got to name them all.
sentences.zh: 一旦你捧红了一个明星，你就得把他们全都捧红。

sentences.en: And that's right there is where the star system is born.
sentences.zh: 而这正是明星制度诞生的地方。

sentences.en: You might understandably think that with all this new fame and prestige,
sentences.zh: 你可能会理所当然地认为，随着所有这些新的名望和声望，

sentences.en: that Hollywood actors would finally come into their power.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞演员最终会掌握自己的权力。

sentences.en: But it didn't quite work out that way.
sentences.zh: 但事情并没有完全按照那样发展。

sentences.en: Instead, executives like Carl Laemmle realized that stardom was a commodity
sentences.zh: 相反，像卡尔·莱姆勒这样的高管意识到，明星效应是一种商品，

sentences.en: that could be manufactured, controlled, and profited from.
sentences.zh: 是可以被制造、控制并从中获利的。

sentences.en: Studios tied up actors in exclusive contracts,
sentences.zh: 制片厂用独家合同束缚了演员，

sentences.en: which meant they could only work for that particular studio.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们只能为那家特定的制片厂工作。

sentences.en: They had nearly complete control over their stars.
sentences.zh: 他们对自己的明星拥有近乎完全的控制权。

sentences.en: So you had not just to go where they wanted you to go,
sentences.zh: 所以你不仅得去他们想让你去的地方，

sentences.en: but you had to be photographed and be photographed how they wanted you to be photographed.
sentences.zh: 而且你必须被拍照，还要按照他们想要的方式被拍照。

sentences.en: So they would tell you to go to Mousseau and Frank's,
sentences.zh: 所以他们会让你去穆索和弗兰克餐厅，

sentences.en: and there'll be some photographers outside,
and you're going to have a dinner inside,
and magically the photographers will find their way inside to a private restaurant.
sentences.zh: 然后奇迹般地，摄影师们就会找到进入这家私人餐厅的路。

sentences.en: Movie studios understood how these public spaces could be used to generate even more star power.
sentences.zh: 电影制片厂明白这些公共空间如何被用来产生更多的明星效应。

sentences.en: So they started exerting control not only over which pictures the stars acted in,
sentences.zh: 所以他们开始不仅控制明星出演哪些电影，

sentences.en: but where they went at night, and with whom.
sentences.zh: 还控制他们晚上去哪里，以及和谁在一起。

sentences.en: If you were not romantically involved with anyone at that time,
sentences.zh: 如果你当时没有和任何人谈恋爱，

sentences.en: they would actually craft a narrative in which you were dating some other celebrity at the studio
sentences.zh: 他们实际上会编造一个故事，说你正在和制片厂的某位名人约会，

sentences.en: or newcomer at the studio that they wanted to promote to help their career.
sentences.zh: 或者是制片厂想要力捧的新人，以帮助他们的事业。

sentences.en: Back then, an appearance at a restaurant like the Brown Derby guaranteed a write-up.
sentences.zh: 那时，在布朗德比餐厅露面就能保证有报道。

sentences.en: Rival gossip columnists Luella Parsons and Hedda Hopper were permanent fixtures inside.
sentences.zh: 竞争对手八卦专栏作家卢埃拉·帕森斯和赫达·霍珀是那里的常客。

sentences.en: It generated publicity for the actors and the restaurants,
sentences.zh: 这为演员和餐厅带来了宣传，

sentences.en: and let fans know where to go if they wanted to see stars in person.
sentences.zh: 也让粉丝们知道如果想亲眼见到明星该去哪里。
与此同时，好莱坞这个街区，

sentences.en: which not long before had its no actors, no animals rule,
sentences.zh: 不久前还有“禁止演员和动物入内”的规定，

sentences.en: quickly capitalized on the film industry and its celebrity status.
sentences.zh: 很快就利用了电影业及其名人地位获利。

sentences.en: If Detroit had its cars, then Hollywood had its stars.
sentences.zh: 如果说底特律有汽车，那么好莱坞就有明星。

sentences.en: The city below looks like any other sprawling metropolis, yet this one is different.
sentences.zh: 下方的城市看起来就像任何其他庞大的大都市，但这座城市与众不同。

sentences.en: Its fame has spread to the four corners of the earth.
sentences.zh: 它的名声已经传遍了世界的每一个角落。

sentences.en: Its name is known to practically every man, woman, and child in the universe.
sentences.zh: 它的名字几乎被宇宙中每一个男人、女人和孩子所熟知。
因为这就是传奇的好莱坞。

sentences.en: The press actually really pushed both the idea of the star
sentences.zh: 媒体实际上确实极力推崇明星的概念，

sentences.en: and the idea of Hollywood as this glamorous, identifiable location.
sentences.zh: 以及将好莱坞作为一个迷人、可辨识的地点这一概念。

sentences.en: And it helped cement this idea that Hollywood itself was such a glamorous area.
sentences.zh: 这有助于巩固好莱坞本身就是一个迷人地区的想法。

sentences.en: Despite its reputation today, the truth is that not many movies are actually filmed in Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 尽管它今天享有盛誉，但事实是，实际上并没有多少电影是在好莱坞拍摄的。

sentences.en: And this was true even back in the day.
Of the five big film studios of the time, MGM, Warner Brothers, Paramount, Fox, and RKO,
sentences.zh: 在当时五大电影制片厂中，米高梅、华纳兄弟、派拉蒙、福克斯和雷电华，

sentences.en: most were located in other parts of Los Angeles, not Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 大多数都位于洛杉矶的其他地区，而不是好莱坞。

sentences.en: Municipally, it is its own thing.
sentences.zh: 从市政角度来看，它有其独立性。

sentences.en: And I think it's always existed parallel to the film industry,
sentences.zh: 我认为它一直与电影业平行存在，

sentences.en: sometimes almost as a parasite of the film industry.
sentences.zh: 有时几乎像是电影业的寄生虫。

sentences.en: But movie makers understood the power of branding.
sentences.zh: 但电影制作人明白品牌的力量。

sentences.en: And so the name Hollywood became synonymous with entertainment.
sentences.zh: 因此，“好莱坞”这个名字成了娱乐的代名词。

sentences.en: One of the most interesting aspects of Hollywood is the motion picture industry.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞最有趣的方面之一是电影工业。

sentences.en: This vast empire is also a potent factor in the economic life of Southern California.
sentences.zh: 这个庞大的帝国也是南加州经济生活中的一个重要因素。

sentences.en: Its studios employ thousands of workers, electricians, carpenters, painters, seamstresses,
sentences.zh: 它的制片厂雇佣了成千上万的工人，电工、木匠、油漆工、裁缝，

sentences.en: artists, artisans of every conceivable kind.
sentences.zh: 艺术家，以及各种各样的工匠。

sentences.en: Throughout the 1930s, MGM studios had actors like Clark Gable and Judy Garland on their roster.
sentences.zh: 在整个20世纪30年代，米高梅制片厂旗下拥有克拉克·盖博和朱迪·加兰这样的演员。

sentences.en: Dorothy Arzner, the director whose star I saw in the Walk of Fame, was at the peak of her career.
sentences.zh: 我在星光大道上看到过她的星星的导演多萝西·阿兹纳，当时正处于她事业的巅峰。

sentences.en: She worked extensively with Paramount Studios, where she directed 11 features in five years.
sentences.zh: 她与派拉蒙影业广泛合作，在那里她五年内执导了11部故事片。

sentences.en: The movie industry was one of the biggest businesses in the world.
sentences.zh: 电影业是世界上最大的商业之一。

sentences.en: And as it reached the height of its power, film became the economic lifeblood of Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 随着它达到权力的顶峰，电影成为了洛杉矶的经济命脉。
没有什么能阻止好莱坞。

sentences.en: Nothing except for the Supreme Court.
So the Paramount decision of 48, it affected all of the major studios.
sentences.zh: 所以1948年的派拉蒙判决影响了所有主要的制片厂。

sentences.en: The Paramount decision was a landmark antitrust ruling that went after the big five movie studios who dominated Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 派拉蒙判决是一项具有里程碑意义的反垄断裁决，旨在打击统治好莱坞的五大电影制片厂。

sentences.en: That's the number one thing that destabilized the industry.
sentences.zh: 这是导致行业不稳定的头号原因。

sentences.en: And that was kind of the very slow decline of the industry and their power.
sentences.zh: 那可以说是该行业及其权力非常缓慢的衰落。

sentences.en: Basically, the big five had a powerful monopoly over the entire motion picture industry.
sentences.zh: 基本上，五大制片厂对整个电影工业拥有强大的垄断权。

sentences.en: They controlled everything from the production of films right down to the theaters that screened them.
sentences.zh: 他们控制着从电影制作到放映电影的影院的一切。

sentences.en: If a studio owned a movie theater, it could shut out its competition by refusing to play any film from a rival company.
sentences.zh: 如果一家制片厂拥有一家电影院，它可以通过拒绝播放竞争对手公司的任何电影来排挤竞争对手。

sentences.en: The 1948 rule put an end to that, making studios give up control of their movie theaters and sell them to independent companies,
sentences.zh: 1948年的裁决结束了这种情况，迫使制片厂放弃对电影院的控制权，并将它们卖给独立公司，

sentences.en: which was great for competition, but bad for the system Hollywood had been built on.
sentences.zh: 这对竞争有利，但对好莱坞赖以建立的体系来说却是坏事。

sentences.en: On top of that, in the late 40s and early 50s, Americans were flocking to newly constructed suburbs far away from the city centers where movie palaces were located.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，在40年代末和50年代初，美国人纷纷涌向远离电影宫所在市中心的新建郊区。

sentences.en: Movie theater attendance dropped by 60 percent in some markets.
sentences.zh: 在一些市场，电影院的上座率下降了60%。

sentences.en: It just dropped like a stone.
And the studios were panic-stricken for good reason.
sentences.zh: 制片厂感到恐慌是有充分理由的。

sentences.en: The Hollywood film industry was suffering, and with it, the District of Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞电影业陷入了困境，好莱坞区也随之受损。

sentences.en: Retail had gone into a state of decline because people weren't coming over the hill to shop like they once did.
sentences.zh: 零售业陷入了衰退，因为人们不像以前那样翻山越岭来购物了。

sentences.en: Leron Gubler says that residents who fled over the hill for the San Fernando Valley suburbs weren't just ditching a night out at the Picture Palace.
sentences.zh: 勒隆·古布勒说，那些逃离山丘前往圣费尔南多谷郊区的居民，不仅仅是放弃了在电影宫度过的夜晚。

sentences.en: They were ditching the entire local economy.
sentences.zh: 他们是在抛弃整个当地经济。

sentences.en: It seemed as though the industry and the neighborhood were in crisis.
sentences.zh: 看起来这个行业和这个街区都陷入了危机。

sentences.en: So in 1953, in response to declining revenue and a distinct lack of good old Hollywood oomph,
sentences.zh: 因此，在1953年，为了应对收入下降和好莱坞老派活力明显不足的问题，

sentences.en: Stewart, who was the volunteer president of the Chamber of Commerce, came up with an idea.
sentences.zh: 斯图尔特的人，他是商会的志愿主席，想出了一个主意。

sentences.en: It was a plan to hearken back to the old, glorious days of Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 这是一个旨在回溯好莱坞昔日辉煌岁月的计划。

sentences.en: He said the tourists come here looking for stars and are disappointed, so let's give them stars.
sentences.zh: 他说游客来这里寻找明星却感到失望，所以让我们给他们明星吧。

sentences.en: The Chamber announced in a press release that they were proposing an attraction that would maintain the glory of a community
sentences.zh: 商会在一份新闻稿中宣布，他们提议建立一个景点，以保持一个社区的荣耀，

sentences.en: whose name means glamour and excitement in the four corners of the world, the Walk of Fame.
sentences.zh: 这个社区的名字在世界四个角落都意味着魅力和兴奋，这就是星光大道。

sentences.en: The idea would be to take the ethereal stars from the screen and place them into the ground where anyone could visit them.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是将银幕上虚无缥缈的明星带下来，放在地上，让任何人都能参观。

sentences.en: Instead of hoping, and then failing, to bump into William Holden at the Brown Derby,
sentences.zh: 与其希望在布朗德比餐厅偶遇威廉·霍尔登却落空，

sentences.en: you can at least know that you'll have a small piece of him along Hollywood and Vine.
sentences.zh: 你至少可以知道，在好莱坞大道和藤街，你将拥有他的一小部分。

sentences.en: And then as you're strolling along to take a picture of Humphrey Bogart or Claudette Colbert's star,
sentences.zh: 当你漫步拍照，拍下亨弗莱·鲍嘉或克劳黛·考尔白的星星时，

sentences.en: oh, hey, maybe you'll pop into Woolworths to buy a new handbag or duck into Musso and Frank's for a steak lunch.
sentences.zh: 哦，嘿，也许你会顺便去伍尔沃斯买个新手提包，或者溜进穆索和弗兰克餐厅吃顿牛排午餐。

sentences.en: So when they were designing the stars, what they were actually going to look like, there was a lot of discussion.
sentences.zh: 所以当他们设计星星，即它们最终的样子时，进行了很多讨论。

sentences.en: No one quite knows where the original idea came from,
sentences.zh: 没有人确切知道最初的想法来自哪里，

sentences.en: but Leron believes the inspiration for the design of the walk came from the ceiling of the dining room in the Hollywood Hotel.
sentences.zh: 但勒隆认为，星光大道设计的灵感来自好莱坞酒店餐厅的天花板。

sentences.en: A lot of celebrities hung out there and in their dining room, on the ceiling,
sentences.zh: 很多名人在那里消磨时光，在他们的餐厅里，在天花板上，

sentences.en: they had stars with the names of celebrities in there.
sentences.zh: 他们有刻着名人名字的星星。

sentences.en: And if you look at those stars, they are very similar to what ended up in the ground.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看那些星星，它们与最终出现在地上的星星非常相似。

sentences.en: The Chamber of Commerce created four committees with experts in four separate categories.
sentences.zh: 商会成立了四个委员会，由四个不同类别的专家组成。

sentences.en: Motion pictures, television, audio recording, and radio.
The first members of the Motion Picture Committee included industry giants,
sentences.zh: 电影委员会的第一批成员包括行业巨头，

sentences.en: DeMille, Samuel Goldwyn, and Walt Disney.
sentences.zh: 德米尔、塞缪尔·戈尔德温和华特·迪士尼。

sentences.en: They combed through thousands of names dating back to the earliest days of Hollywood
sentences.zh: 他们梳理了追溯到好莱坞最早时期的数千个名字，

sentences.en: in order to decide who deserved to be honored on the brand new Walk of Fame.
sentences.zh: 以决定谁有资格在全新的星光大道上获得荣誉。

sentences.en: At this time, there was a kind of cosmic shift taking place.
sentences.zh: 当时，发生了一种宇宙级的转变。

sentences.en: By the 1950s and 60s, the actors who had inspired that new kind of yearning were changing.
sentences.zh: 到了50和60年代，那些激发了那种新渴望的演员们正在发生变化。

sentences.en: While the town and the film business were still relatively young,
sentences.zh: 虽然城镇和电影业仍然相对年轻，

sentences.en: the movie stars fueling the industry were not.
sentences.zh: 但推动这个行业的电影明星却不再年轻了。

sentences.en: The classic stars were getting old.
sentences.zh: 经典的明星们正在变老。

sentences.en: And stars aren't supposed to get old.
sentences.zh: 而明星是不应该变老的。

sentences.en: And what happens when a star gets old?
sentences.zh: 当明星变老时会发生什么？

sentences.en: We really hadn't come to grips with that as a culture.
sentences.zh: 作为一种文化，我们真的还没有完全接受这一点。

sentences.en: But you get into the post where and Cable's getting old and Crawford's getting old.
sentences.zh: 但你进入了战后时期，盖博老了，克劳馥也老了。

sentences.en: And all these things are just changing.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情都在改变。

sentences.en: A permanent ode to the great stars that made Hollywood itself great
sentences.zh: 对让好莱坞变得伟大的伟大明星们的永久颂歌，

sentences.en: seemed like a very appropriate tribute.
sentences.zh: 似乎是一个非常恰当的致敬。

sentences.en: The Walk debuted with a sort of soft open with the unveiling of eight stars.
sentences.zh: 星光大道以一种软启动的方式首次亮相，揭幕了八颗星星。

sentences.en: And in 1961, after years of debate over where it would go and who would be honored
sentences.zh: 1961年，经过多年关于它应该建在哪里、谁应该获得荣誉的争论，

sentences.en: if the color scheme would clash with the neighborhood
sentences.zh: 以及配色方案是否会与街区冲突，

sentences.en: and if Charlie Chaplin was indeed a communist,
sentences.zh: 还有查理·卓别林是否真的是共产主义者，
星光大道终于安装完毕了。

sentences.en: They put in 1,500 stars all at once to create an instant tourist attraction.
sentences.zh: 他们一次性放入了1500颗星星，以创造一个即时的旅游景点。

sentences.en: The Chamber of Commerce wanted to acknowledge that this would be a living monument.
sentences.zh: 商会想承认这将是一个活生生的纪念碑。

sentences.en: So it left about 500 stars blank as placeholders for future recipients.
sentences.zh: 所以它留下了大约500颗空白的星星作为未来获奖者的占位符。

sentences.en: This was a pragmatic move because, let's be honest,
sentences.zh: 这是一个务实的举动，因为说实话，

sentences.en: of those first eight names unveiled on the Walk of Fame,
sentences.zh: 在星光大道上揭幕的那最初八个名字中，

sentences.en: chances are you didn't recognize most, if any, of them.
sentences.zh: 你很可能认不出其中大多数人，如果说有的话。

sentences.en: The Chamber knew that the industry was fickle,
sentences.zh: 商会知道这个行业是反复无常的，

sentences.en: that people would eventually forget about their old favorites
sentences.zh: 人们最终会忘记他们旧日的宠儿，

sentences.en: and move on to the next big star in line,
sentences.zh: 并转向下一个排队的大明星，

sentences.en: whether that was Farrah Fawcett or Francis Ford Coppola.
sentences.zh: 无论是法拉·福塞特还是弗朗西斯·福特·科波拉。

sentences.en: It's a permanent memorial dedicated to a fleeting concept, fame.
sentences.zh: 这是一个献给转瞬即逝的概念——名声——的永久纪念碑。

sentences.en: Although it began as a ploy to generate business,
sentences.zh: 虽然它最初只是为了创造商业利益的策略，

sentences.en: the Walk of Fame ended up tapping into that intimate connection
sentences.zh: 但星光大道最终触及了那种亲密的联系，

sentences.en: people feel for their favorite performer.
sentences.zh: 人们对他们最喜欢的表演者所感受到的那种联系。

sentences.en: The same one that had fans writing to movie studios in the early days of cinema,
sentences.zh: 就像电影早期粉丝写信给电影制片厂时那样，

sentences.en: begging to learn the names of the girl with the curls or the biograph girl.
sentences.zh: 恳求知道“卷发女孩”或“传记女孩”的名字。

sentences.en: The Walk of Fame allows people to feel that they are in the presence of,
sentences.zh: 星光大道让人们感觉到他们仿佛置身于这些人的存在之中，

sentences.en: in the sort of privy to whatever stardust, whatever magic these people had.
sentences.zh: 仿佛分享了这些人所拥有的任何星尘、任何魔力。

sentences.en: There's that gulf between, you know, us and them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们和他们之间存在着那道鸿沟。

sentences.en: And there are very few places that bridge it with physicality.
sentences.zh: 而能用实体形式跨越这道鸿沟的地方少之又少。

sentences.en: And that is the story of how the Walk of Fame saved Hollywood.
